sources.title: 经常项目外汇业务指引（2020年版）— SAFE Notice 汇发〔2020〕14号 with Annexes (State Council Gazette 2020 No. 31)
sources.publisher: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) via gov.cn
sources.method: full-page fetch, chunks 1, 2 and 9 of 10 (Arts. ~36-120, 166-189, issuing Notice, Annex 2)
sources.status_note: Listed as currently effective (#30) in SAFE's catalogue as of 2026-06-30 (E03), but amended since by 汇发〔2023〕8号, 汇发〔2023〕28号 and 汇发〔2024〕11号. The text read here is the as-issued 2020 version; no consolidated text was located.

quotes.orig: 为进一步优化营商环境，便利市场主体办理经常项目外汇业务，国家外汇管理局全面整合相关法规，形成《经常项目外汇业务指引（2020年版）》（见附件1），并废止部分规定（见附件2）。本通知自发布之日起施行。此前规定与本通知不一致的，按照本通知执行。
quotes.en: To improve the business environment and make current-account FX business easier for market participants, SAFE has comprehensively integrated the relevant rules into the Guidelines for Current-Account FX Business (2020 edition) (Annex 1) and repealed certain provisions (Annex 2). This Notice takes effect on issuance. Where earlier provisions are inconsistent with this Notice, this Notice applies.

quotes.orig: 7.《国家外汇管理局关于进一步完善个人结售汇业务管理的通知》（汇发〔2009〕56号）
quotes.en: 7. SAFE Circular on Further Improving the Administration of Individual FX Settlement and Sale (Huifa [2009] No. 56)

quotes.orig: 21.《国家外汇管理局关于进一步完善个人外汇管理有关问题的通知》（汇发〔2015〕49号）
quotes.en: 21. SAFE Circular on Further Improving Issues of Individual FX Administration (Huifa [2015] No. 49)

quotes.orig: 27.《国家外汇管理局综合司关于外籍人员持外国人永久居留身份证办理结售汇业务有关事宜的通知》（汇综发〔2017〕59号）
quotes.en: 27. SAFE General Dept. Notice on FX settlement/sale by foreign personnel holding the Foreigner's Permanent Residence ID Card (Huizongfa [2017] No. 59)

quotes.orig:
境外个人在境内取得的经常项目合法人民币收入，凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的购汇资金来源材料（含税务凭证）在银行办理购汇。
持有外国人永久居留身份证的境外个人适用购汇年度便利化额度。
quotes.en: A non-domestic individual's lawful current-account RMB income earned in China may be converted at a bank on presentation of the individual's valid ID and source-of-funds materials showing the transaction amount (including tax certificates). A non-domestic individual holding a Foreigner's Permanent Residence ID Card is subject to the annual convenience amount for FX purchases.

quotes.orig: 对于现行法规或依据不明确，或超出现行规定但符合改革方向且真实合理的业务需求，外汇分支局可根据具体情况按程序通过集体审议处理，或逐级上报国家外汇管理局，但不得新增或变相新增行政许可。
quotes.en: Where current rules are unclear, or a genuine and reasonable business need goes beyond current rules but fits the reform direction, a SAFE branch may handle it by collective deliberation under procedure, or escalate to SAFE, but may not add administrative licences.

quotes.orig: 违反本指引规定的，由外汇局依据《中华人民共和国外汇管理条例》及相关规定予以处罚。
quotes.en: Violations of these Guidelines are penalised by SAFE under the PRC Foreign Exchange Administration Regulations and related provisions.

quotes.orig: 个人经常项目外汇业务应具有真实、合法的交易背景。个人结汇和境内个人购汇实行年度便利化额度管理，便利化额度分别为每人每年等值5万美元。
quotes.en: Individual current-account FX business must have a genuine and lawful transaction background. Individuals' FX sales and domestic individuals' FX purchases are subject to an annual convenience amount, USD 50,000 equivalent per person per year for each.

quotes.orig: 境外个人原兑换未用完的人民币兑回外汇，凭本人有效身份证件和原兑换水单办理，原兑换水单的兑回有效期为自兑换日起24个月；对于当日累计兑换不超过等值500美元（含）以及离境前在境内关外场所当日累计不超过等值1000美元（含）的兑换，可凭本人有效身份证件办理。
quotes.en: A non-domestic individual converting unused, previously exchanged RMB back into FX does so on valid ID and the original exchange slip, which is valid for conversion back for 24 months from the exchange date; conversions of up to USD 500 equivalent per day, and up to USD 1,000 equivalent per day at in-country venues beyond the customs line before departure, can be handled on valid ID alone.

quotes.orig: 个人不得以分拆等方式规避便利化额度管理及真实性管理。外汇局对规避管理的个人实行“关注名单”管理。……（三）“关注名单”内个人的关注期限为列入“关注名单”的当年及之后连续2年。在关注期限内，“关注名单”内个人办理个人结售汇业务，应凭本人有效身份证件、有交易额的相关材料在银行办理。银行应按照真实性审核原则，严格审核相关材料。
quotes.en: Individuals must not evade convenience-amount management or authenticity review by splitting or similar means. SAFE manages individuals who evade the rules through a 'watch list'. ... (3) The watch period is the year of listing and the following two consecutive years; during it, the individual's FX purchases and sales at banks require valid ID and materials showing the transaction amount, which banks must review strictly under the authenticity principle.
quotes.note: Elided items (1)-(2): risk-warning letters for lending one's own convenience amount; watch-list entry for borrowing others' amounts or other evasion.

quotes.orig: 境外个人经常项目外汇汇出境外，按下列规定在银行办理：（一）外汇账户内外汇汇出，凭本人有效身份证件办理；（二）持外币现钞汇出，当日累计等值1万美元以下（含）的，凭本人有效身份证件办理；超过上述金额的，凭本人有效身份证件、经海关签章的《海关申报单》或原存款银行外币现钞提取单据办理。
quotes.en: A non-domestic individual's current-account FX remittance abroad is handled at the bank as follows: (1) from an FX account - on valid ID; (2) remitting foreign cash - up to USD 10,000 equivalent per day on valid ID; above that, valid ID plus a customs-stamped Declaration Form or the original foreign-cash withdrawal slip.

quotes.orig: 银行可根据个人风险状况，自主决定审核凭证的种类、形式以及审核要点，确保交易真实合规。银行有权对违反外汇管理规定、真实性存疑的交易予以拒绝。对拒绝办理的业务，银行应向个人准确说明拒绝原因及申诉渠道。
quotes.en: Banks may, based on the individual's risk profile, decide the types and forms of documents and the review points. Banks have the right to refuse transactions that breach FX rules or whose authenticity is in doubt; for refused business the bank must tell the individual accurately the reason and the appeal channel.

quotes.orig:
第八十六条　个人提取外币现钞当日累计等值1万美元以下（含）的，凭本人有效身份证件在银行办理；个人出境赴战乱、外汇管制严格、金融条件差或金融动乱的国家（地区），确有需要提取超过等值1万美元以上外币现钞的，凭本人有效身份证件、提钞用途等材料向银行所在地外汇局事前报备。……
第八十七条　个人存入外币现钞当日累计等值1万美元以下（含）的，凭本人有效身份证件在银行办理；超过上述金额的，凭本人有效身份证件、经海关签章的《海关申报单》或原存款银行外币现钞提取单据在银行办理。
quotes.en: Art. 86: withdrawing foreign cash up to USD 10,000 equivalent per day is handled at the bank on valid ID; for travel to war-torn or strict-FX-control or poor-financial-condition countries, withdrawing more than USD 10,000 requires a prior filing with the SAFE branch where the bank is located (valid ID plus materials on the purpose). Art. 87: depositing foreign cash up to USD 10,000 equivalent per day is handled on valid ID; above that, valid ID plus a customs-stamped Declaration Form or the original withdrawal slip from the bank of original deposit.
quotes.note: Elided: validity of the SAFE filing form (30 days, single use).

quotes.loc: Art. 89 (carrying foreign cash across the border)
quotes.orig:
个人携带外币现钞等入境，超过等值5000美元的应向海关书面申报。当天多次往返及短期内多次往返者第二次及以上入境，不论携带外币现钞的金额大小，均应向海关书面申报。
个人携带外币现钞出境，没有或超出最近一次入境申报外币现钞数据记录的，金额在等值5000美元以上至1万美元（含）的，应向银行申领《携带外汇出境许可证》。个人赴战乱、外汇管制严格、金融条件差或金融动乱的国家（地区），确有需要携带超过等值1万美元外币现钞出境的，需向存款或购汇银行所在地外汇局申领《携带外汇出境许可证》。
quotes.en: Carrying foreign cash into China above USD 5,000 equivalent must be declared to Customs in writing (second and later entries on the same day or within a short period must be declared whatever the amount). Carrying foreign cash out, where there is no record of, or the amount exceeds, the most recent entry declaration: USD 5,000 up to and including USD 10,000 requires a Foreign Exchange Carry-out Permit from a bank; for travel to war-torn, strict-FX-control or poor-financial-condition countries, carrying more than USD 10,000 requires a permit from the SAFE branch where the deposit or purchase bank is located.
quotes.note: The article provides a permit route above USD 10,000 only for those listed destinations; it is silent on other destinations.

quotes.orig: 办理单笔等值5万美元以上的服务贸易对外支付，境内机构和个人应先按照服务贸易对外支付税务备案有关规定办理备案手续，银行应核验服务贸易等项目对外支付纸质或电子税务备案表。
quotes.en: For a single services-trade payment abroad above USD 50,000 equivalent, domestic institutions and individuals must first complete tax record filing under the services-trade outbound-payment tax-filing rules, and the bank must verify the paper or electronic tax record filing form.
quotes.note: Scope: services-trade payments by 境内机构和个人 (e.g. fees to a foreign provider); it is not the rule for converting one's own RMB income under Art. 59.

quotes.orig: 个人可委托近亲属代为办理年度便利化额度内的结汇和购汇。……个人可委托他人（含近亲属）代为办理不占用年度便利化额度的结汇和购汇。办理时需提供委托人和受托人的有效身份证件、委托书和有交易额的相关材料等。
quotes.en: Individuals may entrust close relatives to handle FX sales and purchases within the annual convenience amount. ... Individuals may entrust others (including close relatives) to handle FX sales and purchases that do not use the annual convenience amount, providing the principal's and the agent's valid IDs, a power of attorney and materials showing the transaction amount.

quotes.loc: Art. 67 (transfers between a domestic and a non-domestic individual)
quotes.orig: 个人外汇账户内资金境内划转，仅限于本人账户之间、个人与近亲属账户之间。划转账户分别属于境内个人、境外个人的，按跨境交易进行管理，且应符合经常项目外汇汇出境外的规定。
quotes.en: Domestic transfers of funds in individuals' FX accounts are limited to transfers between the individual's own accounts and between the individual and close relatives' accounts. Where the accounts belong respectively to a domestic and a non-domestic individual, the transfer is managed as a cross-border transaction and must comply with the rules for remitting current-account FX abroad.

quotes.loc: Art. 58 (the opposite direction: FX into RMB, for context)
quotes.orig: 境外个人凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的结汇资金用途材料，在银行办理不占用年度便利化额度的经常项目结汇。结汇单笔等值5万美元以上（不含）的，应将结汇所得人民币资金直接划转至交易对方的境内人民币账户。
quotes.en: A non-domestic individual converts FX into RMB for current-account purposes on valid ID and materials showing the use of the RMB, without using the annual convenience amount; for a single conversion above USD 50,000 equivalent, the RMB must go directly to the counterparty's domestic RMB account.
quotes.note: Context only - this is the inbound direction.

quotes.orig: 银行应加强电子银行个人结售汇业务风险识别，落实电子银行业务本人办理原则。通过多重技术手段，事中事后筛查拦截异常外汇交易，防范借用他人便利化额度、出借本人便利化额度及其他规避便利化额度和真实性管理的违规行为。
quotes.en: Banks must strengthen risk identification for e-banking FX purchases and sales and apply the principle that e-banking business is done by the person. Using multiple technical means, they must screen and intercept abnormal FX transactions during and after the event, to prevent borrowing or lending of convenience amounts and other violations that evade convenience-amount and authenticity management.

quotes.loc: Arts. 56-57 (domestic individuals above the convenience amount; purchase application)
quotes.orig:
第五十六条　境内个人凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的结汇资金来源材料，在银行办理不占用年度便利化额度的经常项目结汇。
境内个人凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的购汇资金用途材料，在银行办理不占用年度便利化额度的经常项目购汇。
第五十七条　境内个人办理购汇业务，应真实、准确、完整填写《个人购汇申请书》，并承担相应法律责任。
quotes.en: Art. 56: a domestic individual may, on valid ID and materials showing the source and amount of the funds, convert current-account FX into RMB without using the annual convenience amount; and, on valid ID and materials showing the use and amount, buy current-account FX without using it. Art. 57: a domestic individual buying FX must fill in the Individual FX Purchase Application truthfully, accurately and completely and bears legal responsibility.

sources.title: SAFE Tianjin FAQ on foreigners' wages (quotes Guidelines Art. 59)
sources.status_note: Published 2026-07-13, i.e. after the 2023-24 amendments to the Guidelines; it quotes Art. 59 of 汇发〔2020〕14号.

quotes.orig: 境外个人在境内工作期间取得的劳动报酬如何购汇汇出？答：根据《国家外汇管理局关于印发〈经常项目外汇业务指引（2020年版）〉的通知》（汇发〔2020〕14号）第五十九条规定，“境外个人在境内取得的经常项目合法人民币收入，凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的购汇资金来源材料（含税务凭证）在银行办理购汇”。
quotes.en: How may a non-domestic individual convert and remit remuneration earned while working in China? Answer: under Art. 59 of the Guidelines (汇发〔2020〕14号): 'A non-domestic individual's lawful current-account RMB income earned in China may be converted at a bank on valid ID and source-of-funds materials showing the transaction amount (including tax certificates).'

sources.title: SAFE Notice 汇发〔2021〕13号 on further facilitating individual current-account FX business
sources.status_note: Listed in SAFE's 2026-06-30 catalogue (E03.c).

quotes.loc: Item 5 (non-domestic individuals working in China: salary purchases)
quotes.orig: 五、优化在华工作境外个人薪酬购汇手续。对于在华工作境外个人劳动合同有效期内到同一银行再次办理合法薪酬收入购汇，银行可根据首次办理情况，免于审核重复性材料，并在购汇备注栏标注“便利化薪酬购汇”字样。
quotes.en: 5. Streamline salary purchases for non-domestic individuals working in China: during the validity of the labour contract, when buying FX again at the same bank with lawful salary income, the bank may, based on the first transaction, skip re-reviewing repeated materials and mark the purchase remark 'facilitated salary purchase'.

quotes.orig: 六、银行应建立个人经常项目特殊外汇业务处置制度，并事前向所在地外汇局书面报告。对于个人具有真实、合法交易背景的经常项目外汇业务，银行应坚持“实质重于形式”的审核原则，按照个人经常项目特殊外汇业务处置制度予以办理，并在购/结汇备注栏标注“特殊外汇业务处置”字样。
quotes.en: 6. Banks must set up a special-case procedure for individual current-account FX business and report it in writing to the local SAFE branch beforehand. For individual current-account FX business with a genuine, lawful transaction background, banks must apply a 'substance over form' review and handle it under that procedure, marking the remark 'special FX business handling'.

sources.title: Measures for the Administration of Individual Foreign Exchange (PBOC Decree [2006] No. 3), English text
sources.status_note: Listed in SAFE's 2026-06-30 catalogue (#2). English text is a reference translation.

quotes.en: non-domestic individual refers to a foreign citizen holding a non-Chinese passport…
quotes.note: Quoted from my notes up to the ellipsis; the full sentence continues on the page.

quotes.en: Summary (paraphrase): Art. 9 - annual limit covers all individuals' FX sales plus domestic individuals' purchases; Art. 13 - a non-domestic individual may convert legitimate RMB current-account income earned in China into FX and remit it with ID plus documents; Art. 14 - unused remitted-in FX returns via the original route; Art. 22 - housing-sale proceeds convertible and remittable; Art. 26 - transfers of property abroad under separate rules; Art. 28 - the bank assigns the owner category by ID.

sources.title: PRC Foreign Exchange Administration Regulations (State Council Decree No. 532), Chinese text
sources.status_note: Listed in SAFE's 2026-06-30 catalogue (#1).

quotes.en: Summary (paraphrase): fines up to 30% of the amount (30%-100% if serious) for illegal evasion/arbitrage conduct; carrying FX across the border in violation - warning and fine up to 20% (Customs penalties prevail); individuals - fines up to RMB 50,000 for certain violations; Art. 52(2) - 'domestic individual' includes Chinese citizens and foreigners continuously resident for at least one year.

quotes.orig: 年度便利化额度不是个人每年购汇或者结汇的限额，只是超过等值5万美元的购汇或结汇不能仅凭本人有效身份证件办理

quotes.en: A person willfully violating this subchapter or a regulation prescribed or order issued under this subchapter (except section 5315, 5324, or 5336 ...) ... shall be fined not more than $250,000, or imprisoned for not more than five years, or both.

A person willfully violating this subchapter ... while violating another law of the United States or as part of a pattern of any illegal activity involving more than $100,000 in a 12-month period, shall be fined not more than $500,000, imprisoned for not more than 10 years, or both.

the amount of any civil penalty ... shall not exceed $10,000. ... sources.title: 26 U.S.C. 988 - Treatment of certain foreign currency transactions (U.S. Code, 2024 edition)
sources.status_note: Provides the official-text replacement for the Cornell mirror the other layers cite.

quotes.en: In the case of any disposition of any nonfunctional currency - such disposition shall be treated as a section 988 transaction ... the term 'nonfunctional currency' includes coin or currency, and nonfunctional currency denominated demand or time deposits or similar instruments issued by a bank or other financial institution.

The preceding provisions of this section shall not apply to any section 988 transaction entered into by an individual which is a personal transaction. ... If (A) nonfunctional currency is disposed of by an individual in any transaction, and (B) such transaction is a personal transaction, no gain shall be recognized for purposes of this subtitle by reason of changes in exchange rates after such currency was acquired by such individual and before such disposition. The preceding sentence shall not apply if the gain which would otherwise be recognized on the transaction exceeds $200.

sources.publisher: People's Bank of China, with seven other agencies including SAFE
sources.status_note: Takes effect on issuance and repeals 银发〔2021〕237号. Cited by session 7e08715a as its S08; read independently here.

quotes.orig: 虚拟货币相关业务活动属于非法金融活动。在境内开展法定货币与虚拟货币兑换业务、虚拟货币之间的兑换业务、作为中央对手方买卖虚拟货币、为虚拟货币交易提供信息中介和定价服务、代币发行融资以及虚拟货币相关金融产品交易等虚拟货币相关业务活动，涉嫌非法发售代币票券、擅自公开发行证券、非法经营证券期货业务、非法集资等非法金融活动，一律严格禁止，坚决依法取缔。
quotes.en: Virtual-currency business activity is illegal financial activity. Within China, exchanging legal tender for virtual currency, exchanging virtual currencies, acting as central counterparty, providing information-intermediary and pricing services, token-issuance financing and trading virtual-currency financial products are suspected of being illegal financial activity and are strictly prohibited and to be shut down according to law.
quotes.note: Elided: the list of suspected offences is kept in full in the original.

quotes.orig: 金融机构（含非银行支付机构）不得为虚拟货币相关业务活动提供账户开立、资金划转和清算结算等服务
quotes.en: Financial institutions (including non-bank payment institutions) must not provide account opening, fund transfer, clearing or settlement services for virtual-currency business activity.

quotes.orig: 本通知自发布之日起施行。中国人民银行等十部门《关于进一步防范和处置虚拟货币交易炒作风险的通知》（银发〔2021〕237号）同时废止。
quotes.en: This Notice takes effect on issuance. The 2021 ten-agency Notice on further preventing and handling the risk of virtual-currency trading speculation (银发〔2021〕237号) is repealed at the same time.
